tagline: Connect Linear engineering sprints to Salesforce opportunities and cases
metaDescription: Track features tied to Salesforce opportunities and turn cases into Linear bugs. GAIA escalates deal blockers. See the setup steps.
intro:
Enterprise sales teams rely on Salesforce to manage opportunities and customer cases, while engineering teams build and ship in Linear. When a customer-blocking bug or a deal-winning feature is in the engineering backlog, the CRM has no visibility into its progress — and account executives are left manually chasing engineering updates before customer calls.

GAIA connects the two so customer-facing teams always have accurate engineering status. Salesforce cases linked to known bugs receive automatic progress updates. Feature requests attached to high-value opportunities are tracked as Linear issues with revenue context baked in. When engineering ships, the related records update automatically.

For enterprise software companies with dedicated sales engineering and customer success teams, this integration eliminates an entire category of internal coordination work that currently consumes hours every week.

useCases.title: Opportunity-linked feature tracking
useCases.description: Sales reps attach feature requests to Salesforce opportunities. GAIA creates corresponding issues tagged with the opportunity value so product teams can prioritize by revenue impact.

useCases.title: Case-to-bug issue creation
useCases.description: When a case is escalated as a product bug, GAIA opens a Linear issue with full case context and keeps the case status updated as the bug moves through the fix cycle.

useCases.title: Deal stage-triggered engineering escalation
useCases.description: When an opportunity moves to Negotiation or Close Won and has open engineering dependencies, GAIA escalates the linked issues to ensure delivery commitments are met.

useCases.title: Customer delivery notifications
useCases.description: When an issue tied to an opportunity ships, GAIA triggers a task for the account executive to notify the customer, keeping the relationship warm.

useCases.title: Engineering roadmap in reports
useCases.description: GAIA syncs project and cycle completion data to custom objects so sales leadership can include engineering delivery timelines in account planning reports.

howItWorks.step: Connect Linear and Salesforce to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Linear workspace and Salesforce org in GAIA's settings. GAIA uses Connected App OAuth for the org and API tokens for the workspace, requesting only the permissions your workflows need.
Define which objects (opportunities, cases, accounts) should link to issues, and which issue status changes should write back to record fields.

howItWorks.step: GAIA syncs engineering progress to the CRM automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA runs continuously in the background, keeping records updated with the latest issue status so sales teams always have accurate information for customer conversations.

faqs.question: Can GAIA link a single Linear issue to multiple opportunities?
faqs.answer: Yes. A platform issue or widely-requested feature can be linked to multiple opportunities. When it ships, all linked records are updated and tasks are created for each account executive.

faqs.question: Does GAIA write to standard fields or custom fields?
faqs.answer: Both. GAIA can update standard fields like Case Status and create or update custom fields you define. The mapping is fully configurable without code.

faqs.question: Can this integration help with CPQ or contracts?
faqs.answer: Indirectly. If a contract or quote is linked to an opportunity with engineering dependencies tracked in the engineering workspace, GAIA can surface the issue status on the opportunity record visible to your CPQ workflow.

faqs.question: Is this suitable for teams with Salesforce Enterprise or higher?
faqs.answer: Yes. The integration works with Professional, Enterprise, and Unlimited editions. API access is required, which is available on Enterprise and Unlimited, and as an add-on for Professional.
